status: A proposed set of five events. The client records them only when analyticsEndpoint is set in data/config.json; today it is empty, so nothing is sent and no traffic figure exists.
privacy: No cookies. No IP address stored. No user-agent stored. No fingerprinting. No cross-site identifiers. Counts are aggregated per day, and browsers sending Do Not Track are not counted at all.

events.name: product_view
events.fires: When a product page or product card is shown, once per page load.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires: When a reader clicks a buy link. The link is not redirected; the browser goes straight to the Amazon URL.

events.name: guide_read_75
events.fires: When a reader scrolls past 75 percent of a guide.

why_no_redirect: The Program Policies prohibit cloaking the URL of a site that carries Special Links, including by sending readers indirectly through an intermediate page. A redirect-based click counter is exactly that pattern, so the counter records the click in the browser and lets the link go straight to Amazon.
